_scenario_note: 実績OPM(FY2023-FY2026): 13.68 -> 12.61 -> 11.08 -> 9.29% と【4期単調低下】。min 9.29 / p25 10.64 / med 11.84 / p75 12.87 / max 13.68%。■単調トレンドはサイクルではないため、Base を実績中央値(11.84%)へ機械的に収束させると根拠のない回復を仮定することになる。単調系列に対する規則として Base の到達OPM = (直近実績 + 実績中央値)/2 = 10.57% とし、低下の下げ止まりと緩やかな改善のみを織り込んだ。Upside は max(p75 12.87, 直近+1.0pt=10.29) = 12.87%。Downside 1 は min(p25 10.64, 直近 9.29) = 9.29% を下回る 7.2%。Downside 2 は実績トラフ(9.29%)が直近実績そのものでトラフとして機能しないため、売上-10%+OPM半減アーム。■COGS%は実績40.3-41.2%と安定しているため固定し、SGA% = 100% - OPM - COGS% で構成した(実績SGA%は46.0 -> 49.6%と上昇)。
investment_thesis: Yakult sells a single fermented-dairy franchise through a direct sales network, which gives it an unusually stable gross margin even as the operating margin has fallen for four consecutive years; the shares trade at {per} earnings and {pb} book.
The balance sheet holds net cash, so enterprise value sits below market capitalisation and the {wacc} discount rate is the cost of equity with no leverage benefit assumed.
At {price} the market is extrapolating the margin decline; a base case that only halts the slide, without restoring the historical median, still supports {target_price}, or {upside_pct} from here.
key_risks: The operating margin has fallen in each of the last four years as selling costs rose faster than revenue, and nothing in the filings yet confirms the stabilisation the base case assumes behind {target_price}.
Overseas volume, particularly in China, drives group growth and is not hedged in the {wacc} applied here.
Revenue has been flat to negative for three years, so the terminal growth assumed in this model is above what the recent record supports at {price} and {per}.
